warnings.label: Tidal Thames riverside from Putney Bridge to Teddington Weir
warnings.description: Tidal Thames riverside from Putney Bridge to Teddington Weir
warnings.county: Greater London, Hammersmith and Fulham, Hounslow, Richmond upon Thames, Wandsworth
warnings.eaArea: Kent, South London and East Sussex
warnings.message:
There is no longer a threat of flooding, though standing water and debris may still remain. 
Tidal conditions are expected to improve and no flooding is expected.   
We will continue to monitor the situation and will issue further alerts or warnings if necessary.   
Never drive through flood water,  just 30cm of fast flowing water is enough to move your car. Continue to take care on waterside roads and footpaths and don't put yourself in unnecessary danger.
